label: Ticker in the score file
definition: Read as text. The tickers NA and TRUE exist.

label: Year label in the score file
definition: Meaning (fiscal or filing year) is not stated in the codebook; tested in step 04.

label: CUSIP in the score file
definition: Nine characters to 2023, eight in 2024, empty in rows without a score.

label: Count score
definition: 1 if the 10-K mentions biodiversity in at least two sentences.

label: Negative score
definition: Negative biodiversity sentences minus positive ones in the 10-K.

label: Regulation score
definition: 1 if count = 1 and at least one of the sentences is about regulation.

label: Compustat firm identifier
definition: Six characters, zero padded. Firm key of the panel.

label: First eight characters of the CUSIP
definition: First merge key between scores and Compustat.

label: Ticker
definition: Second merge key, used only for rows not matched on CUSIP.

label: Company name
definition: For reading and spot checks only.

label: Fiscal year
definition: Time key of the panel. Tobin's Q is measured at the end of this fiscal year.

label: Month of the fiscal year end
definition: Used for the December-only checks.

label: Score year attached to the firm-year
definition: t_fyear - 1 under the fiscal convention, t_fyear under the filing convention.

label: How the score was matched
definition: cusip8, ticker or none.

label: Country of incorporation
definition: Sample keeps USA.

label: Reporting currency
definition: Sample keeps USD.

label: SIC code
definition: Historical code where available. 6000-6999 is excluded.

label: Two-digit SIC
definition: floor(ind_sic / 100).

label: GICS industry group
definition: Four-digit code. Industry key for fixed effects and exposure.

label: Common equity
definition: Book value of equity.

label: Market value of equity
definition: Share price at fiscal year end times shares outstanding.

label: Tobin's Q
definition: (AT - CEQ + PRCC_F x CSHO) / AT.

label: Log of Tobin's Q
definition: ln(dv_tobin_q).

label: Tobin's Q, winsorised
definition: dv_tobin_q clipped at its 1st and 99th percentile. Main dependent variable.

label: Log of Tobin's Q, winsorised
definition: Robustness check R1.

label: Industry-adjusted Tobin's Q
definition: dv_tobin_q_w minus the median of its industry group and fiscal year. Robustness check R2.

label: Count score, clean
definition: count as integer.

label: Negative score, clean
definition: negative as integer.

label: Regulation score, clean
definition: regulation as integer.

label: Net negative tone
definition: 1 if bd_negative > 0.

label: Count score known before Q is measured
definition: bd_count of t_score_year.

label: Negative score known before Q is measured
definition: bd_negative of t_score_year.

label: Regulation score known before Q is measured
definition: bd_regulation of t_score_year.

label: Net negative tone known before Q is measured
definition: bd_negative_pos of t_score_year.

label: Count score disclosed two fiscal years later
definition: Placebo regressor of robustness check R9; same pattern for negative and regulation.

label: Count score of the next score year
definition: Regressor of robustness check R10, the other reading of the score year; same pattern for negative and regulation. Empty when that score year is after 2023.

label: Firm size
definition: ln(AT).

label: Leverage
definition: (DLTT + DLC) / AT. A missing component counts as zero if the other is present.

label: Profitability
definition: OIBDP / AT.

label: Asset tangibility
definition: PPENT / AT.

label: Sales growth
definition: SALE(t) / SALE(t-1) - 1, only when the previous fiscal year is present.

label: R&D intensity
definition: XRD / AT, with missing XRD set to zero.

label: R&D not reported
definition: 1 if XRD is missing.

label: Capital expenditure
definition: CAPX / AT.

label: Cash holdings
definition: CHE / AT.

label: Dividend payer
definition: 1 if DVC > 0.

label: Winsorised controls
definition: Each continuous control clipped at its 1st and 99th percentile. Used in every model.

label: Survey score, transition risk
definition: Share of respondents naming the industry as affected by transition risk.

label: Survey score, physical risk
definition: Share of respondents naming the industry as affected by physical risk.

label: Survey score, average
definition: Average of the two shares.

label: Survey score, standardised
definition: ind_bio_survey_avg standardised across non-financial industry groups.

label: Holdings-based industry score
definition: Industry market weight minus weight in biodiversity funds, scaled by market weight.

label: CDP-based industry score
definition: Value-weighted share of firms with activities in or near biodiversity-sensitive areas.

label: Financial or real estate industry group
High biodiversity exposure industry
definition: 1 if ind_bio_survey_avg is above the two-thirds quantile of the non-financial groups.

label: After the Kunming Declaration
definition: 1 for fiscal years from 2022 (the declaration is dated October 2021).

label: Firm-level climate change exposure (optional)
definition: Exposure in t_score_year. Present only if the climate file is supplied.

label: Score times high-exposure industry
definition: For count, negative and regulation.

label: Score times ev_post
definition: For count, negative and regulation.

label: Industry group by fiscal year
definition: ind_gics4 and t_fyear joined; fixed-effect key of the main models.
